name: Musca Macedda Swarm
body:
Musca Macedda Swarm
CR 4

A furious buzzing rises from this hovering mass of black dots, ready to surround and devour their victim.

XP 1,200
N Diminutive vermin (swarm)
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 17, flat-footed 14 (+3 Dex, +4 size)
hp 44 (8d8+8)
Fort +7, Ref +5, Will +3
Defensive Abilities swarm traits; Immune mind-affecting effects, weapon damage

OFFENSE

Speed 5 ft., climb 5 ft., fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Melee swarm (2d6 plus bleed)
Space 10 ft., Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks bleed (1d6), distraction

STATISTICS

Str 1, Dex 11, Con 13, Int –, Wis 12, Cha 2
Base Atk +6; CMB –; CMD –
Skills Climb +9, Fly +15, Perception +5; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception

ECOLOGY

Environment any temperate or tropical
Organization solitary, pair, plague (3-6 swarms), or scourge (7-12 swarms)
Treasure incidental

Swarms of musche macedde can be found in marshes or, according to tales, in dungeons, guarding treasure. A jar containing a swarm would be placed next to an identical one containing gold, and only the adventurers’ wit or luck in choosing the right jar makes the difference between success and sudden, painful death.

Variants

While the deinos is based on the legendary Mares of Diomedes from the labors of Heracles, you could easily create similar docile creatures turned into bloodthirsty monsters using the following template.

Special Attacks: A carnivorous creature gains the following special attacks.

Blood Rage (Ex)

The creature gains the blood rage universal monster ability.

Hunger Frenzy (Ex)

Once per day when it has not eaten any meat for more than 12 hours, a carnivorous creature can enter a blood rage without taking damage. This blood rage lasts until the end of the battle or until it has performed at least one rending bite attack against a corporeal opponent. This functions otherwise as the blood rage universal monster ability.

Rending Bite (Ex)

Whenever a carnivorous creature confirms a critical hit with its bite attack against a corporeal opponent, it can rend the opponent’s flesh with its teeth and swallow part of it. This deals additional damage to the victim equal to the carnivorous creature’s usual bite damage plus 1-1/2 its Strength. This ability functions otherwise as the normal rend monster special attack.

Ability Scores: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +4, Int +4.
